### NetApp Hosts Technology Sessions at 2026 INSIGHT Conference in Las Vegas, Nevada


September 22, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/371534297/files/doc_news/NetApp-Hosts-Technology-Sessions-at-2026-INSIGHT-Conference-in-Las-Vegas-Nevada-2026.pdf)


SUNNYVALE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


NetApp (NASDAQ: NTAP) will hold their 2026 INSIGHT™ customer conference in Las Vegas, Nevada on September 29 – October 1, 2026.


On Tuesday, September 29, 2026, NetApp will host a technology session for financial analysts and investors from 11:00 a.m. – 3:00 p.m. Pacific Time. The event will include George Kurian, Chief Executive Officer; Syam Nair, Chief Product Officer; Wissam Jabre, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer and several tech specialists discussing NetApp’s differentiation and value proposition in the areas of enterprise storage, AI, cloud transformation, data infrastructure modernization, and cyber resilience. Kris Newton, Vice President, Investor Relations, will moderate a customer panel.


Furthermore, NetApp will also host a keynote session of mainstage headliners from 9:00 – 10:15 a.m. Pacific Time which will include special tech luminaries, industry leaders and entertainment icons.


**How to Participate**


Live video webcasts of both events will be available at[http://investors.netapp.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Finvestors.netapp.com%2F&esheet=54608363&newsitemid=20260922895461&lan=en-US&anchor=http%3A%2F%2Finvestors.netapp.com&index=1&md5=f44663ccffcfe9df2e273c575fb8d354) . A webcast replay of the events will be available at[http://investors.netapp.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Finvestors.netapp.com%2F&esheet=54608363&newsitemid=20260922895461&lan=en-US&anchor=http%3A%2F%2Finvestors.netapp.com&index=2&md5=c633eabfed2eb4322724cff98f575eb1) approximately 24 hours after the event.


**About NetApp**


For more than three decades, NetApp has helped the world’s leading organizations navigate change – from the rise of enterprise storage to the intelligent era defined by data and AI. Today, NetApp is the Intelligent Data Infrastructure company, helping customers turn data into a catalyst for innovation, resilience, and growth.


At the heart of that infrastructure is the NetApp data platform – the unified, enterprise-grade, intelligent foundation that connects, protects, and activates data across every cloud, workload, and environment. Built on the proven power of NetApp ONTAP, our leading data management software and OS, and enhanced by automation through the AI Data Engine and AFX, it delivers observability, resilience, and intelligence at scale.


Disaggregated by design, the NetApp data platform separates storage, services, and control so enterprises can modernize faster, scale efficiently, and innovate without lock-in. As the only enterprise storage platform natively embedded in the world’s largest clouds, it gives organizations the freedom to run any workload anywhere with consistent performance, governance, and protection.


With NetApp, data is always ready – ready to defend against threats, ready to power AI, and ready to drive the next breakthrough. That’s why the world’s most forward-thinking enterprises trust NetApp to turn intelligence into advantage.
